description.value: A longitudinal MRI study comparing regional rates of brain atrophy over time in genetic and sporadic frontotemporal dementia.

spans.text: We aimed to assess whole brain and regional rates of atrophy in MAPT, GRN and C9ORF72, as well as sporadic FTD, using large cohorts of subjects with multiple longitudinal MRI.

Subjects with GRN mutations showed the fastest rates of atrophy, with particularly fast rates in parietal lobes.
MAPT and C9ORF72 showed the slowest overall rates of atrophy, suggesting these are relatively slowly progressive variants of FTD.
The sporadic FTD group showed disproportionately fast rates of atrophy in the frontal lobes, particularly the anterior cingulate gyrus.
